markdown_report:
**Recommendation:** test a jointly trained, scratch-initialized, order-sensitive title/description residual inside the corrected HSTU. Compare against ID-only and mean-pooling ablations trained separately; deploy one checkpoint per category. Gains remain unmeasured.

**Insights from the starting point**

1. Electronics has 10.71% sampled wrong rankings and a −0.0749 tenth-percentile margin. This supports investigating discrimination, without establishing held-out ranking performance.
2. Collapse scores near 0.5 imply average cosine similarity near zero. They do not justify a collapse penalty.
3. Users report broad associations and overlooked connector/format distinctions. Available text offers clues; physical compatibility and completed needs remain unlabeled.

**Insights from related work**

1. [HSTU’s configuration](https://github.com/meta-recsys/generative-recommenders/blob/main/configs/ml-1m/hstu-sampled-softmax-n128-final.gin) supplies a normalized, temperature-scaled objective reference. Its MovieLens settings are unverified here.
2. [SCE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.18721) motivates informative negatives. Aggressive mining risks false negatives, so begin with uniform sampling.
3. [MMSR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.17372v1) motivates joint content learning, but uses pretrained encoders. [Deep Averaging Networks](https://aclanthology.org/P15-1162/) support simple text baselines, while permutation invariance makes reversed connector strings indistinguishable under mean pooling.

**Framework and candidate assessment**

Prospective O/P/U/M/D scores denote originality, potential, user alignment, model alignment and difficulty; higher D means harder. Alignment scores describe hypotheses, not demonstrated effects.

| Direction / atomic idea | O/P/U/M/D | Positive assessment | Negative assessment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Objective: moderate hard-negative curriculum, following SCE | 3/7/5/9/4 | Targets weak margins | Established mechanism; false negatives; compatibility remains implicit |
| Temporal representation: recent-history gate within HSTU | 4/7/8/5/5 | Targets stale interests | Completed needs remain unobserved; margin benefit uncertain |
| Item representation: scratch mean-text residual, following MMSR | 3/6/7/7/5 | Simple attribute sharing | Established fusion; loses order; scratch learning uncertain |
| Item representation: scratch ordered-text residual | 3/7/8/7/6 | Can distinguish direction and attribute order | More implementation work; sensitivity need not mean correctness |

**Selected experiment**

At 0% progress, select the ordered-text residual: token embeddings, width-3 convolution, masked pooling and projection added to ID embeddings through a conservative global gate. It explicitly targets **broad thematic recommendations** and **overlooked connector/format distinctions**; Electronics’ weak separation is its model-facing target. It does not establish compatibility or infer fulfilled needs.

```python
text = masked_pool(conv3(token_embeddings(tokens)))
e = normalize(id_embedding + has_text * sigmoid(gate) * project(text))
h = corrected_hstu(left_padded_history, e)
loss = cross_entropy([cos(h, e_positive), cos(h, e_negatives)] / 0.05)
```

Use 128 uniform negatives with replacement, excluding padding, targets and known training positives; retain duplicate multiplicities. Name this **uncorrected sampled cross-entropy**, not a catalog-softmax estimator. Keep this objective identical across ablations.

Preserve seeds 0/42, four routes, supplied splits, maximum 200 epochs and 200 batches/epoch. Read the final nonpadding position. Share `encode_items` across training, prediction and diagnostics; serialize tokenizer, text table, architecture and weights. Update the predictor writer. Cache fused items only after loading the selected checkpoint in evaluation mode; verify cached/uncached scores agree.

Select by pinned macro validation HR@10; report Electronics separately. Track train–validation gaps and title-derived brand-only/specification-only ablations. Use token shuffles and reversed-connector minimal pairs as auxiliary sensitivity checks, following [probing methodology](https://aclanthology.org/P18-1198/); sensitivity is not correctness. Never equate training margins with held-out gains.

idea.description: Add a small, randomly initialized, order-sensitive title/description residual to the corrected HSTU’s shared item representations. Train token embeddings, a width-3 convolution, item embeddings and HSTU jointly as one network per category. Compare separately trained ID-only and mean-pooling ablations under the same objective; the final predictor loads exactly one checkpoint per category.
idea.motivation: Targets two observed user failures: broad thematic relevance replacing specific intent, and overlooked connector or media-format distinctions. Unlike mean pooling, an order-sensitive encoder can represent different connector directions and local attribute assignments. This capacity does not guarantee that interaction supervision teaches correct compatibility. Multi-negative training addresses the measured weak separation in Electronics, while validation must establish any ranking benefit. Neither text nor interactions supply labels for fulfilled needs, physical compatibility or simulator traits.
idea.implementation_notes:
Preserve the corrected HSTU backbone, causal attention, multiplicative gating and existing position/time mechanisms. Use DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']; retain all four routes and supplied splits, and write artifacts beneath the trial directory. Keep preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, at most 200 epochs and exactly 200 batches per completed epoch. Do not use external weights, extra datasets, held-out interactions for negative filtering, other trials or checkpoint averaging.

Build a deterministic category-local vocabulary from supplied training-accessible titles/descriptions. Normalize Unicode and whitespace while preserving connector direction words, model identifiers, numbers, units, dimensions and format strings. Save the exact tokenizer configuration, vocabulary and token table; use reserved PAD and UNK tokens, distinguish title and description boundaries, and document deterministic truncation. A concrete initial configuration is 128 tokens/item, minimum token frequency 2, vocabulary capped at 30,000 tokens with lexical tie-breaking, 32-dimensional token embeddings, a width-3 convolution with 64 output channels and GELU, and masked mean pooling followed by projection to the baseline HSTU item dimension. This configuration is a proposal, not an established optimum. Convolution windows must not connect title and description across a field boundary; encode fields separately with shared weights and pool their valid outputs. Re-mask padded positions after convolution so biases cannot introduce pooled padding features. Preserve the baseline HSTU dimensions and optimizer configuration; initialize the global text-gate logit to -3. Add token dropout of 0.1 during training as a preregistered regularizer, without dropping padding masks.

Implement one differentiable encode_items(ids): obtain ID embeddings and text features, fuse as e_id + has_text * sigmoid(gate) * projection(text), L2-normalize with epsilon 1e-8, then explicitly zero item 0. Apply has_text after projection so its bias cannot create contributions for missing metadata. Exclude padded tokens from pooling and clamp denominators. Share this representation between history inputs, targets, negatives, diagnostics and cache construction. Normalize HSTU output features before scoring, and use cosine logits divided by temperature 0.05 consistently. These normalization and temperature choices change the baseline objective and therefore belong in every ablation, including ID-only.

Use uncorrected sampled cross-entropy with one positive and K=128 independent uniform negative draws with replacement per supervised position. The eligible pool excludes padding, the target and every known training positive for that user, using training data only. Preserve duplicate draws as repeated denominator entries. Skip supervision positions with no eligible negatives rather than looping indefinitely. Compute CE over the positive and 128 negative logits at valid causal positions; average over valid positions. This objective learns discrimination against the specified sampler and is not claimed to approximate unrestricted catalog softmax. Do not silently introduce logQ corrections or deduplicate samples. If a future experiment uses importance correction, define it separately: for this deterministic-positive construction, keep the positive logit unchanged and subtract log(K*q_user(i)) from each negative logit after temperature scaling; q_user is conditional on eligibility. Finite-sample log-normalizer estimation still introduces bias.

Preserve item_emb as the host-compatible ID embedding interface and expose encode_items for fused representations. Adapt DiagnosisProbe to call the actual model’s encode_items and predict_score rather than treating raw item_emb weights as fused candidates. Keep log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), family-specific sample_batch, ModelView, user_train, meta_data and review_data compatible. Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader) returning metrics and metric_definitions, and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). The loader remains (None, sequence, positive, negative) with B x L tensors. Report whether embedding similarity is measured on ID or fused embeddings; use fused embeddings for the primary architecture-relevant diagnostic. Do not fabricate category breakdowns or review-derived attributes when those fields are unavailable. Never interpret collapse scores near 0.5 as substantial directional collapse.

For left-padded histories, gather the maximum index whose item is nonzero, never count-1; explicitly handle empty histories using the supplied baseline convention. Do not require future interaction timestamps. Save one selected checkpoint per category containing all learned parameters and preprocessing artifacts, and update the embedded predictor writer with the identical architecture and scoring conventions. Construct checkpoint-specific fused-item caches after model.eval() under torch.inference_mode(); cache only item-dependent features. Do not reuse detached caches across training updates. Chunk full-catalog scoring when needed and preserve exact scores. Verify cached versus uncached scores within floating-point tolerance for ordinary, missing-text and padding items.

The primary experiment compares ordered text against an ID-only control with identical objective and training settings; run the mean-pooling ablation only if the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget permits. Each ablation is independently trained and never fused. Retain the host checkpoint-selection protocol and record actual hyperparameters, validation trajectories and consumed budget. Select using the unchanged four-category macro validation HR@10 and report per-category results, especially Electronics. No improvement is asserted without measured validation evidence.

Audit shortcut learning with title-derived brand-only, specification-only and generic-word removal perturbations; do not assume a brand metadata field exists. Retrained ablations, when budget permits, distinguish reliance from inference-time corruption sensitivity. Use natural same-brand/high-overlap candidates and synthetic reversed-connector, dimension-order and format-token pairs only as auxiliary diagnostics. Measure representation and score changes separately; without compatibility labels they establish sensitivity, not correctness. Track text availability and train–validation gaps. Fixed-seed results cannot establish multi-seed robustness, and repeated validation selection can overfit the validation sample.
idea.pseudocode:
Freeze the supplied splits, category routing, host validation protocol and HSTU cold start.
For each separately trained experimental variant permitted by the remaining budget:
  For each of the four categories:
    Set training seed 42; retain host preprocessing seed 0.
    Build and save the deterministic title/description tokenizer, vocabulary and token table.
    Initialize one corrected HSTU; add either no text, mean text or ordered text according to the variant.
    Define encode_items(ids) with shared fusion, normalization, missing-text masking and explicit item-0 zeroing.
    For at most 200 epochs, perform 200 training batches per completed epoch:
      Obtain the family-specific causal next-item batch.
      Encode history items through encode_items and compute HSTU features.
      Normalize features with epsilon 1e-8.
      For every valid supervised position, draw 128 eligible uniform negatives with replacement.
      Retain duplicate samples; exclude only padding, target and known training positives.
      Compute cosine logits / 0.05 for the positive and all sampled negatives.
      Minimize uncorrected sampled cross-entropy averaged over valid positions.
      Preserve baseline optimizer settings and record the explicit configuration.
    Follow the host validation/checkpoint-selection procedure without modifying its evaluator.
    Serialize one selected checkpoint containing parameters, architecture and text preprocessing artifacts.
Compare variants using fixed macro validation HR@10; never combine their scores or weights.
Write working/predict.py through the predictor writer using the selected architecture.
Load exactly one checkpoint/category; call eval(), then build fused-item caches under inference_mode().
Verify cache equivalence and gather the final nonpadding history position at inference.
Run the preserved diagnostic interfaces on actual fused scores; report measured metrics and definitions.
Run budget-permitting text perturbation and retrained shortcut ablations as auxiliary diagnostics.
Deploy only the selected single model per category; make no unmeasured performance claims.

originality.positive: Combines a small order-sensitive, scratch-trained text residual with the required HSTU and explicitly tests specification-sensitive behavior under restricted data access.
originality.negative: CNN text encoders and ID/content fusion are established techniques; the contribution is a controlled adaptation and diagnostic design rather than a new architecture principle.

future_potential.positive: Provides a reproducible route to testing whether local textual attributes improve sequential ranking and information sharing for sparsely observed items.
future_potential.negative: Sparse recommendation supervision may reward brands or generic words instead of compatibility distinctions; incomplete text and absent compatibility labels limit conclusions.

code_difficulty.positive: A small convolutional encoder is feasible without external weights and permits exact cached candidate scoring within one network.
code_difficulty.negative: Field-aware masking, shared fused representations, diagnostic adaptation, checkpoint serialization, sampling semantics and embedded predictor consistency require substantial integration care.

related_work.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Trillion-Parameter Sequential Transducers for Generative Recommendations
contributions: Introduces HSTU with pointwise attention and multiplicative feature interactions.
Provides the required backbone family for the proposed extension.
limitations: Does not establish the proposed scratch-trained text residual’s effectiveness on these four Amazon datasets.

related_work.title: Official HSTU MovieLens sampled-softmax configuration
contributions: Provides a concrete reference using 128 negatives, normalized representations and temperature 0.05.
limitations: MovieLens settings are not evidence of optimal Amazon hyperparameters.
The reference does not make different sampling corrections or loss conventions interchangeable.

related_work.title: Scalable Cross-Entropy
contributions: Motivates learning from informative catalog candidates through approximate maximum-inner-product search.
limitations: Does not demonstrate gains under this fixed HSTU benchmark.
Informative unobserved candidates may include false negatives.

related_work.title: MMSR
contributions: Studies joint adaptation of content encoders and sequential recommendation modules and their fusion.
limitations: Uses pretrained content encoders, which are unavailable under this task’s constraints.
Does not validate the proposed randomly initialized text encoder.

related_work.title: Deep Unordered Composition Rivals Syntactic Methods for Text Classification
contributions: Establishes deep averaging networks as useful unordered text-classification baselines.
Motivates retaining mean pooling as a controlled low-complexity ablation.
limitations: Does not establish recommendation or physical-compatibility understanding.
Context-independent mean pooling cannot distinguish token sequences with identical multisets.

related_work.title: What You Can Cram into a Single Vector: Probing Sentence Embeddings for Linguistic Properties
contributions: Provides probing tasks for word content and word-order information.
Motivates measuring representation sensitivity separately from downstream ranking.
limitations: Connector-direction and dimension-assignment probes are proposed product-specific adaptations.
Probe sensitivity alone does not establish correct compatibility judgments.

related_work.title: TensorFlow sampled_softmax_loss documentation
contributions: Documents sampled-softmax behavior and accidental target-hit handling.
limitations: Excluding every known training positive requires additional user-specific handling.
Its expected-count correction convention differs from the deterministic-positive importance estimator.

related_work.title: Candidate Sampling
contributions: Explains candidate-sampling objectives and expected-count semantics.
Supports specifying proposal probabilities and duplicate handling explicitly.
limitations: Does not establish that a particular correction or sampler improves this benchmark.
Replacement draws and unique-set inclusion probabilities require different corrections.

related_work.title: On the Bias of Sampled Softmax
contributions: Analyzes bias associated with sampled-softmax estimation.
Supports distinguishing sampled discrimination from catalog-normalizer approximation.
limitations: Does not identify an optimal negative count or objective for these four categories.
Importance weighting does not generally eliminate finite-sample loss or gradient bias.

related_work.title: TensorFlow Recommenders factorized top-k implementation
contributions: Provides an implementation reference for precomputed candidate embeddings and exact brute-force scoring.
limitations: Globally cached embeddings require item-only candidate representations.
Training updates invalidate detached candidate caches; approximate retrieval may alter rankings.

related_work.title: PyTorch embedding implementation
contributions: Documents embedding lookup and padding-index semantics.
limitations: Padding-index behavior does not mask downstream projection biases, convolutions or fusion outputs.

related_work.title: PyTorch functional.normalize documentation
contributions: Specifies normalization dimensions and epsilon semantics needed for consistent scoring.
limitations: Consistent normalization alone does not guarantee useful ranking representations.

related_work.title: PyTorch inference_mode documentation
contributions: Documents inference execution without autograd bookkeeping.
limitations: Inference mode does not call model.eval() or disable dropout automatically.
